# NDSP V1.4 Completed Decisions Discovery Baseline — 20260709_082445

## Current known behavior

- /api/completed-decisions may return 404.
- completed-decisions-review.html is read-only and handles empty/error states.
- V14-A must discover the real source before any API/Nginx change.
